source: Aquinas, Summa Theologica I.2.3 (First Way, condensed)
text: Some things in the world are in motion. Whatever is in motion is put in motion by something else, since nothing can move itself from potentiality to actuality except by something already actual. This chain of movers cannot regress infinitely, because without a first mover there would be no subsequent motion at all. Therefore there must exist a first, unmoved mover, which everyone understands to be God.
